text:
iris: FYI onboarding delta-lite-11b (int4) is flaking in canary — repeated OOMs during spikey chat loads. stack traces + dmesg look like slab fragmentation + big default max_new_tokens=512.

sam: ugh. do we have a minimal repro? alloc logs?

iris: pasted quick logs below, cropped: 
```
2026-03-02T14:12:03Z kernel: gpu0: out_of_memory allocating 1.2GiB
runtime: alloc slab#47 free=6MB used=3.1GB (fragmented)
request: model=delta-lite-11b int4 seq=1024 max_new_tokens=512
stack: runtime::kv_cache::alloc -> slot_compactor -> kernel_alloc
```

leo: first thought — default max_new_tokens=512 is too aggressive for this quant profile. suggests lowering default to 128 for int4 variants until we stabilize. also try a soft batch-window throttle (15-25ms) to avoid big transient batches during bursts.

anya: can we enable a "slowspill" fallback — evict lower-priority KV to host memory earlier (not full evict) so we avoid big host swap thrash? i.e., partial spill threshold at 75% GPU mem. reduces fragmentation amplification.

sam: +1 on lowering max_new_tokens. also recommend allocating a small slot-reserve for delta-lite (slot_reserve=10MB) to give compactor some breathing room. without reserve compactor winstry stalls and then OOMs.

iris: plan I'm proposing: 
- create canary image with default max_new_tokens=128 for delta-lite-11b:int4
- set batch_window_ms=20 for the canary route
- enable slowspill with partial_threshold=0.75 and spill_rate=0.6
- bump slot_reserve to 10MB for the model profile
I'll run a 2h smoke with load-generator (rps bursts) and capture llm-serving metrics (alloc_hist, slab_free, evict_count).

leo: sounds good. for perf bench, add a microbenchmark: 10k short chats (prompt len 64) and 500 long sessions (prompt len 1024) to see impact on p99 latency. watch for increased CPU host IO when slowspill enabled.

anya: also add a small quality check — lowering max_new_tokens may change downstream generation length/gap. put a quick eval harness comparing sample completions against baseline for 200 prompts. we should gate if avg cohens_d > 0.05 on metric.

sam: operational note — set a soft throttle policy: if slab_fragmentation_index > 0.4 then cap concurrency to X (config: concurrency_soft_cap=0.6) rather than hard rejecting. better UX for clients.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/delta-lite-11b-int4 -> 1725010800. Alert rule: canary_swap_io > 100MB/s for 5m -> rollback.

iris: starting canary job now, uploading patch PR with config changes. will dump post-canary logs here. thanks for quick ideas :thumbsup:

sam: if you hit weird regressions ping me, I can instrument heap tags and trace compactor calls.

leo: i'll queue the perf jobs. keep notes on p50/p95/p99 and cost/tokens too.

iris: noted. starting load in ~10m. will post results + a short summary.
